_comment: Round-trip truth table for engine-code shorthand (PRD-FBS-FIT-002 §9.3). The API's jest suite asserts that expandSlashToken(compressed) === codes; the web suite asserts that compressEngineCodes(codes) === compressed. The two implementations live in different packages (there is no shared package in this repo), so this shared fixture is what stops them drifting apart.
_notCompressible_comment: Cases that must render separately. Compression is cosmetic, so every guard fails safe.

notCompressible.why: empty tail - NA vs turbo must stay visibly distinct
empty tail - variant suffixes carry mechanical meaning
shared prefix too short to be meaningful
a single code is not a group
tails differ in length, ambiguous in reverse
group larger than the readable cap
one code is the other's base - shared-suffix reading would drop the plain 4JA1
trailing segments differ, nothing shared to factor out

_suffix_comment: Shared-SUFFIX cases: the mirror of the right-aligned overlay, for code families that differ at the front (the common Toyota style). The shared part is always a whole hyphen-delimited segment, which is what makes it unambiguous to expand back.
